annotations.title: Freeze a compiled plan (activate the Task)

description: Freezes a reviewed plan as the Task's next version and activates it. Pass the EXACT plan object a compile returned — never hand-edit it (change the sentence and recompile instead). Freeze ONLY after the user has seen the proposal and said go; echo what you're freezing in one line first. In-flight runs keep their pinned versions. After freezing, offer to start a first run.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

plan.description: The plan object from workbench_tasks_compile, verbatim.

sentence.description: The sentence this plan was compiled from.

taskId.description: The task id (create a draft first if none).

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_tasks_freeze
